svg.title: Code Mortis repository overview
svg.desc: Code Mortis Overview in dark mode, recreated as a vector illustration with sample activity and security data. The reviews card shows two open findings. The security card shows Grade D with seven open findings, including three high-severity findings. The activity calendar shows 248 runs across 365 days. Recent review results appear beneath the calendar.

g.aria-label: Code Mortis is a self-hosted workspace for reviewing GitHub pull requests and running security scans, posting findings as comments
while keeping review runs, coverage, and resolution history in one place. Connect your own GitHub App and shared model providers
to review changes with Mortis Engine and scan repositories with Trivy.
Runs counted on the day they were created
PR #58 · feat(pulls): PR overview with saved summary and interactive diagram
